vulnerabilities.description: Temporary files may not be cleaned up on forceful process termination (SIGKILL bypasses finally block)
Weak random ID generation using Math.random() - predictable but acceptable for client-side only storage

recommendations: Run 'npm audit' before production deployment - no current vulnerabilities detected
Enable GitHub Dependabot for automated security alerts
Add signal handlers to github-safe.js (SIGTERM/SIGINT) for proper temp file cleanup
Consider crypto.getRandomValues() for IDs if future API endpoints expose saved results
Ensure deployment environment sets secure headers (CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options)
Monitor security advisories for Next.js, React, and TypeScript dependencies
security_strengths: No hardcoded API keys, passwords, or secrets
No SQL injection risks (file/JSON based storage)
XSS vulnerabilities properly mitigated (React escaping, sandboxed iframe)
Input validation on helper utilities and calculators
Type-safe TypeScript implementation prevents many vulnerability classes
HTTPS usage for external script loading (Google Analytics, AdSense)
Proper iframe sandboxing with origin isolation
